verses.html: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
verses.text: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

verses.html: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

verses.html: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.text: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

verses.html: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.text: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

verses.html: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.text: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

verses.html: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.text: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

verses.html: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
verses.text: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

verses.html: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.text: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

verses.html: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.text: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

verses.html: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.text: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

verses.html: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.text: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

verses.html: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.text: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.html: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.text: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

verses.html: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
verses.text: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

verses.html: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.text: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

verses.html: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.html: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
verses.text: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

verses.html: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.text: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.html: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

verses.html: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.text: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.html: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.text: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

verses.html: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.text: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

verses.html: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.text: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

verses.html: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.text: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

verses.html: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.text: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

verses.html: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

verses.html: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.text: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

verses.html: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.text: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
